rationale: C09 is a concrete, material drafting template for the child. It concerns the same designated justice, the same Puerto Rico federal judgeship, and reproduces nearly the entire operative sentence, including authority to sign papers, service without extra compensation, the vacancy/death/absence/illness/disability conditions, and a concluding annual limitation. The child principally updates Snyder's judicial title, reverses the court-name phrasing, and changes the year from 1952 to 1954. C23 follows the same expanded template for a different justice and year, while C16 is an earlier, slightly narrower version lacking the vacancy and death language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder, Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate and authorize the Honorable A. Cecil Snyder, Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of Puerto Rico
shared_material.explanation: The same opening formula designates the same individual, with only his updated title and the court's updated style changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the United States District Court for the District of Puerto Rico, and to sign all necessary papers and records as acting judge of the said district court, without extra compensation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to perform and discharge the duties of the office of Judge of the District Court of the United States for Puerto Rico, and to sign all necessary papers and records as acting judge of the said district court, without extra compensation
shared_material.explanation: This is near-verbatim operative machinery; the principal difference is a minor reordering of the federal court's name.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in case of vacancy in the office of judge of the said district court, or in case of the death, absence, illness, or other legal disability of the judge thereof, during the year 1954
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in case of vacancy in the office of judge of the said district court, or in case of the death, absence, illness, or other legal disability of the judge thereof, during the year 1952
shared_material.explanation: The triggering conditions and annual limitation are identical apart from updating the year.
